profile:
# The SDS800X HD as the browser demo simulates it, in the core's profile
# schema (open-dso-core/profile). The firmware builds this unit's profile in
# code at bring-up (app/internal/scopeboard/scopeboard.go, from the unit's
# identity); this file states the same values for the four-channel 200 MHz
# variant, which the demo's simulated board needs before any bring-up.

channels: 4

# 12-bit converter codes left-aligned in 16-bit words; mid-screen is 0x8000,
# the screen spans 0x080 … 0xF7F codes (spec 03 §5).
format: {bits: 12, storage: u16, shift: 4, frac: 0, min: 2048, max: 63472, mid: 32768}

# Spec 04 §1: the rate route by channels on.
rates:
  - samples_per_s: 2e9
    max_channels: 1
  - samples_per_s: 1e9
    max_channels: 2
  - samples_per_s: 500e6
    max_channels: 4

max_depth: 100000000
bandwidth: 200e6

content: [raw-full-rate, raw-decimated, peak-pairs]
raw_access:
  max_depth: 10000000
  per_window: true

triggers:
  nodes:
    edge: {slopes: [rising, falling, either]}
    pulse: {qual_ops: [shorter, longer, inside, outside]}
    slope: {slopes: [rising, falling], qual_ops: [shorter, longer, inside, outside]}
    video: {}
    window: {}
    runt: {}
    pattern: {}
    timeout: {}
    protocol: {}
  max_stages: 1
  protocols: [uart, spi, i2c, can, lin]
  sources: [analog]

# 1024x600 with touch (spec 07 §2); the demo draws the traces itself.
display:
  w: 1024
  h: 600
  format: argb8888
  touch: true
  divs_h: 10
  divs_v: 8

# The probe factors and bandwidth limits the product offers (the front
# end's 1-2-5 range and its one 20 MHz limit, spec 06).
vertical:
  probes: [0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000]
  bw_limits: [full, 20M]

# The panel's keys, knob pushes and knobs by the UI model's names (the
# board's input names map spec 08's physical names to these); the vertical
# knobs are shared by the channels on this panel.
inputs:
  keys: [run, single, auto, trigauto, trignormal, defaultsetup, print, menu, measure, cursors, math,
    ref, acquire, display, saverecall, trigmenu, utility, ch1, ch2, ch3, ch4, triglvlpush, tdivpush,
    horizpospush, adjustpush, ch1vdivpush, ch2vdivpush, ch3vdivpush, ch4vdivpush, ch1pospush,
    ch2pospush, ch3pospush, ch4pospush]
  knobs: [tdiv, horizpos, triglevel, adjust, ch1vdiv, ch2vdiv, ch3vdiv, ch4vdiv, ch1pos, ch2pos,
    ch3pos, ch4pos]
  lamps: [adjust, ch1, ch2, ch3, ch4, cursors, measure, math, ref, decode, auto, normal, single,
    run, stop]
  touch: true
  beeper: true

supervisor:
  restart: software-health

options: [counter]

absent:
  logic-probe: "the SLA1016 logic probe is not driven by this firmware"
  generator: "the external signal generator is not driven by this firmware"

budget:
  ram_bytes: 528482304
  cores: 2

stage: 1

# Spec 04: 1 ns/div (200 MHz models) to 1000 s/div.
timebase:
  tdiv_s: [1e-9, 2e-9, 5e-9, 10e-9, 20e-9, 50e-9, 100e-9, 200e-9, 500e-9,
    1e-6, 2e-6, 5e-6, 10e-6, 20e-6, 50e-6, 100e-6, 200e-6, 500e-6,
    1e-3, 2e-3, 5e-3, 10e-3, 20e-3, 50e-3, 100e-3, 200e-3, 500e-3,
    1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000]
  full_rate_tdiv_s: 1e-9

variants:
  - name: sds824x-hd
    match: {model: SDS824X HD}
